name: fluxplace — KiCad engineering suite
description: Signal-flow placement, routing, DFM and fab packaging for KiCad 10 — placement, autorouting, comprehension, sourcing and the manufacturer upload package, end to end.
description_full:
fluxplace is a full PCB engineering suite for KiCad 10, not just a placer. It reads the board's communication graph (power/ground excluded so they do not tie everything together), places components so routing falls out as a tree, runs a placement tournament judged by a real router, pours and stitches planes, laundres copper against DRC, patches walled islands with rip-up-and-reroute, checks every MPN against live DigiKey/Mouser stock before a part reaches copper, and emits the manufacturer upload package (gerbers, drill, centroid, BOM, assembly instructions, order worksheet) shaped to the fab's own upload form.

REQUIRES KiCad 10.0 or newer (pcbnew + kicad-cli). Several capabilities need components pip cannot install: Java and the freerouting 2.3.0+ jar for routing, LibreOffice for the PDF upload slot, and DigiKey/Mouser API credentials for the availability gate. On first run the plugin checks every requirement and offers to install the python packages for you; `fluxplace doctor` does the same from the CLI.
